sections.heading: Your first expedition
sections.body: Lumo Ruins is your first normal combat area. Starting combat creates an ongoing action rather than a single training encounter.

sections.heading: Combat continues
sections.body: Your character keeps resolving encounters over time until you stop the action. Return to Combat to inspect results and progression.

sections.heading: Completing First Steps
sections.body: Start the Lumo Ruins expedition to complete First Steps, receive 150 Cinders, and unlock normal Shenic combat areas.
